name: 💪 +1 Strength to Grow Your Arm！
desc:
💪 Welcome to +1 Strength to Grow Your Arm!

🏋️ Lift weights to gain Strength!
💪 Watch your RIGHT ARM grow BIGGER and STRONGER!
💥 Smash through walls and unlock new areas!
🧠 Find Brainrots hidden behind the walls!
🏃 Bring them back to your base!
💰 Earn Coins and buy even stronger weights!
🔥 Keep training and grow the BIGGEST ARM!

💪 LIFT → GROW → SMASH → COLLECT → EARN → REPEAT!

🏆 How BIG can your arm get?

👍 LIKE the game! Obtain the Mythic-quality Brainrots！
⭐ FAVORITE for more updates!
